articles.summary: ATLANTA – Scripps Sports Network, the free streaming television network launched by The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) earlier this year, will premiere a new original series, “Total Replay with the Makeshift Project,” bringing enormously popular YouTube content to television.
articles.title: Scripps Sports Network brings hit YouTube show to streaming TV Oct. 21

articles.summary: The E.W. Scripps Company has raised its expectations for full-year 2026 midterm Local Media political advertising revenue to about $275 million, which is about 40% above its 2022 midterm election revenue.
articles.title: Scripps raises full-year political guide, completes 2026 workforce reductions

articles.summary: CINCINNATI – The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) will report third-quarter 2026 operating results after the markets close on Thursday, Nov. 5. The call with the company’s senior management team will take place at 9:30 a.m. Eastern time on Friday, Nov. 6.
articles.title: Scripps to release third-quarter 2026 operating results on Nov. 5

articles.summary: Harry Connick Jr. joins award-winning journalist Alisyn Camerota for the season two premiere of “Connected with Alisyn Camerota,” Scripps News’ one-on-one interview series.
articles.title: ‘Connected with Alisyn Camerota’ returns to Scripps News with Harry Connick Jr. and a new season of powerful conversations
